# Real ConnectServer packets, produced by OpenMU's OWN writers - not by reading the layout and
# typing out what it ought to be. Generated with src/Network/Packets:
#
#     var packet = new byte[ServerListResponse.GetRequiredSize(4)];
#     var response = new ServerListResponse(packet) { ServerCount = 4 };
#     response[i].ServerId = ...; response[i].LoadPercentage = ...;
#
# for the four servers listed below. If OpenMU ever changes the layout, regenerating this file is
# what makes the change visible - a hand-written expectation would just keep agreeing with itself.
#
# The layout MIXES ENDIANNESS, which is the whole reason this fixture exists:
#
#   C2          header type
#   00 17       total length, 23 bytes, BIG endian
#   F4 06       code and sub code
#   00 04       server count, BIG endian
#   then 4 bytes per server: server id LITTLE endian, load percentage, one padding byte
#
# servers: id 0 load 37, id 1 load 0, id 258 load 100, id 65535 load 7
serverlist C20017F4060004000025000100000002016400FFFF0700

# The greeting the connect server sends the instant it accepts a connection, before being asked
# anything. C1 header, code 0x00, sub code 0x01.
hello C1040001

# What a game client sends to ask for the list. The probe must send exactly these bytes.
request C104F406
